activities.activity_description: Move Kafka module from XD to s-c-s repo, including code migration, testing, and integration as a sink.
Move Rabbit module from XD to s-c-s repo, including code migration, testing, and integration as a sink.
Design and implement abstraction for pluggable binder types (rabbit, redis, kafka) for module channels.
Add support for external config files to override default module configurations (e.g., Maven coordinates).
Refactor CC SPI deployer using CF Java Client to improve design and performance.
Implement configuration to select Hadoop distribution and load appropriate libraries.
Migrate header-enricher module from modules repo to XD proper.
Upgrade to SI 4.2, Spring 4.2.1, and AMQP 1.5 dependencies.
